products.name: Tiny Acres
products.pitch: A cozy puzzle a day, and acres more.
products.description: One shared puzzle a day: match the edges, and your acre grows into one little landscape. Then Acres, numbered acres without end along a country lane, and Worlds: whole landscapes to piece together. No lives, no timers.

hero_image.alt: Tiny Acres: a little floating island with cottages, a windmill, a lake with a sailing boat, wheat fields and sheep.

share_image.alt: Tiny Acres, a cozy puzzle a day, and acres more: a finished acre in painted 3D floating over Petal Fields' blossom trees and flower strips.

update.name: Acres
update.summary: play on, acre after acre, whenever you like
update.text: Acres takes the big card on your home screen: numbered acres without end, played one after another along a country lane. Finish one, tap Next acre, and a little cart rolls on to the next, with a new backdrop behind your board every acre and milestone flags along the way. New worlds too: Sandy Cove, a sunny bay with dunes, beach huts, a lighthouse and a jetty, and Petal Fields, with tulip and lavender strips, blossom groves and a glasshouse. Worlds now call their places by name, like Village square. Choose Easy, Medium or Hard for Acres and Worlds, while today's acre stays the same for everyone. And the look follows your day: bright by day, dark at night. Free play makes way for Acres; your bests stay in Stats.

screenshots.alt: A cozy puzzle a day, and acres more: the home at 10:00, Acres' big card on Sandy Cove's lane beside Worlds, then Today's Acre and more
Match edges, watch it come alive: a forest has just closed on Acre 57, birds lifting, Petal Fields' blossom and flower strips behind the board
A country lane, acre by acre: the Acres lane along Sandy Cove's beach, medals on the stops behind, the cart at the next acre
Landscape jigsaws to piece together: Lighthouse rock in Sandy Cove, a piece held over its gap, its matching sides gold
Worlds for every season: Petal Fields' path through tulip and lavender strips, Flower market the next place
Bright by day, cozy by night: today's acre, Oak Haven, in the dark look at night, a village of three just closed

features: Match forests with forests and lakes with lakes, and close regions for bonus points.
Acres: numbered acres without end along a country lane, a little cart rolling on to the next, and a new backdrop behind your board every time.
Beat the target for a medal, keep your daily streak, and share your finished acre. Friends can play the same acre and see both side by side.
Worlds: landscapes to piece together at your own pace, from Meadow Valley in spring to Sandy Cove's sunny bay and the flower strips of Petal Fields. Every world is free.
Easy, Medium or Hard, painted 3D tiles, cozy acoustic music and festivals; bright by day, dark at night. Plays fully offline.

money.title: Fair and simple
money.text: Free to play, with a few ads that never interrupt a puzzle. Tiny Acres Plus is one optional, one-time purchase that removes them. No subscription, no in-game currency, no loot boxes.

products.name: Big Deal
products.pitch: One large-print solitaire deal a day.
products.description: The same deal for everyone, checked by computer so it can always be finished. No timer, and unlimited undo.

screenshots.alt: Large print. One deal a day: a solitaire table with big, clear cards, Deal #16, Gentle Monday, par 165.
Tap to move. No clock: a hint suggests moving the three of spades to column 3.
Finish under par for gold: won in 150 moves, par 165, with a gold medal and a 16-day streak.
Every deal checked by computer: the home screen with today's deal and the last seven days.
Readable your way: settings for card size, a four-colour deck, high-contrast cards and a left-handed layout.

features: Large print, in the card size you like: Normal, Large or Extra large.
A four-colour deck, high-contrast cards and a left-handed layout, if you want them.
Tap a card to move it. No clock, and undo as often as you like.
Finish under par for a gold medal, and keep your streak going.
Play past deals from the archive.

money.title: Fair and simple
money.text: Free to play, with a few ads that never appear inside a deal. The first hint in each deal is free. Remove all ads is one optional, one-time purchase. No subscription, no in-game currency, no loot boxes.

products.name: TravelCharika
products.pitch: When to go, and where to book.
products.description: A travel website and apps for Android and iPhone. Each place's twelve months are scored from ten years of measured weather and the holidays that crowd it, so you can see the best time to go.

channels.label: iPhone app
channels.cta: iPhone app on the App Store

features: Every place's twelve months, scored from ten years of measured weather and the public holidays that crowd it.
Which months are good for hiking, the sea, skiing and the northern lights.
The big festivals, carnivals and markets, month by month.
Where to book, once you know when to go.

money.title: How it's paid for
money.text: TravelCharika is free to use. Some of the booking sites it lists pay it a commission; that never decides which sites are listed or in what order.
